speaker: binh
quote: Binh: One coffee sachet, please. The red strip above you. Another early shift.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: Hanh says I still owe a million. I paid her last Friday. She kept the receipt to update her book.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: Just charge me for the coffee today. I am going back for that receipt.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: You see everyone who comes through this alley. If she asks, remember I was here.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Two soup noodle packets and one tin of canned meat, please.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Binh was here, was he? He gets confused about money. Always has.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I keep the neighborhood debt book. Without it, people would forget what they owe.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Of course. I only want the figures to be right. It is a lot of responsibility.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Thank you. If Binh leaves any paper with you, send him to me.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Can I have ten mint candies? From the blue jar!

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Five for me. Five for Binh. He fixed the wheel on my bicycle.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: He said to count them twice. Ten, not nine. He always notices.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Thanks! I will leave his five by his door if he is still out.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: One bottle of beer, please. I have just finished closing the sewing shop.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: Binh was outside Hanh's gate earlier. He had a little folded slip in his hand.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: He kept saying the same thing: "Read the date." She would not let him finish.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: I should go. You can hear every word through those metal gates.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: One coffee sachet. Same as yesterday.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: I found my copy. Friday, one million, paid in full. Her signature is still there.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: I will show it to her tonight. Keep yesterday in your head, all right? People change their stories.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: Three bags of ice, please. My drinks are warm already.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: Good morning for sales. Bad morning for gossip. Hanh told everyone Binh had not paid her.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: I paid her too. Now I am wondering whether I should ask to see my line in that book.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: Thanks. Three bags should get me through the afternoon.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Two stir-fry noodle packets, please. Mum is working late.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Binh did not take the candies. They are still by his door. Maybe he forgot.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: One cola and one tin of fish, please. My son Duy is helping me at the workshop.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: If Duy seems quiet, give him time. He listens longer than most people.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: Just one coffee sachet. I have not slept.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: She changed the date in her book. My receipt says Friday. Her page says I borrowed it again on Saturday.

speaker: binh
quote: Binh: I am taking the receipt to her now. If I do not come back, do not let her say I left owing money.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: One sanitary pad, please. From the purple An Tam pack.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: I heard Hanh lift her gate last night during their earlier dispute. Then a man said, "You cannot cross me out." I thought it was Binh. I saw him walking past my shop alive this morning.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Has Binh been in? He looked exhausted when I saw him.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: He has been worrying over a bit of paper. He ought to get some rest.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I asked him to come over. We will sort out the book this evening.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I need two beers, three orange sodas and two tins of canned meat.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Just neighbors coming round. It is easier to settle these things over a meal.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Thank you. No need to mention our conversation to anyone.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Ten mint candies, please. Like last time.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: Binh was sitting by the drain this morning, before he went to Hanh. He waved and told me he was waiting to speak to her.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: I will get him ten this time. Maybe he did not like sharing.

speaker: bao
quote: Bao: If he comes here, tell him I remembered his five from yesterday.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: Two tins of canned meat, please. I do not want to go out again tonight.

speaker: lan
quote: Lan: Hanh was washing the tiles outside her gate before sunrise. She stopped when she saw me.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Two bottles of water, please. I have been delivering parcels since dawn.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: The woman behind the green gate sent me away. Hanh, I think. Said she had never ordered anything.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: The parcel had Binh's name on it. He used her address for deliveries.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Right. I will keep it at the depot until someone can collect it.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Thanks. I hope he turns up. It is only a box of work gloves.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: One beer, please. I closed the stall early.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: Nobody wanted a drink once the police arrived.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: They found someone in the drainage channel beyond the alley. They put up a sheet before I could see.

speaker: thu
quote: Thu: I keep thinking about Binh asking for his receipt. I wish I had listened.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: Two beers, please. One for me, one for my brother.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: Duy was helping me unload after dark. He heard a heavy scrape by Hanh's gate. Now he will not talk about it.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: If he comes in, let him speak when he is ready. Do not push him.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: One lemon soda, please. The green bottle.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: I took the parcel back. Hanh came to the depot asking for it before we opened.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Then an officer asked whether anyone had tried to collect Binh's things.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Officer Phuc. I gave him the delivery times. Those are written down, at least.

speaker: tuan
quote: Tuan: Keep your records. That was what he told me.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: I am Officer Phuc. I am asking about the man found beyond this alley.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: We have not confirmed his identity. I need times, names, things you actually saw.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: Thank you. May I buy one bottle of water while I am here?

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: I will come back tomorrow. If someone asks you to destroy a receipt or change a date, keep it.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Three soup noodle packets. I need something quick.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: The man by the drain? He was carrying a coffee sachet. It could have been anyone.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I heard it from someone. People are talking everywhere.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: You should ask Sau's son. Duy was out there after dark. I saw him.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Thank you. Do not repeat every rumor you hear.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: Is Hanh still here?

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: One bag of corn snacks, please. I just need a minute.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: I heard Binh at her gate. Please do not tell her I said that.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: I could not sleep. I keep hearing it.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: One bag of corn snacks. The same one.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: I DID NOT TOUCH HIM! I only heard the scrape. Then she told me to go home.

speaker: duy
quote: Duy: I will tell Officer Phuc. I just needed to say it to someone first.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: Duy is my son. He was unloading with me that night. He could not have hurt Binh.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: He heard an argument, then something being dragged. He has been afraid Hanh would come for him too.

speaker: sau
quote: Sau: I am taking him to Phuc now. Thank you for letting him finish.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: I have news about Binh. May I step out of the rain for a moment?

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: Thank you for the coffee. We have identified the man in the drainage channel.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: Binh. His family confirmed it this afternoon.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: We found a wet payment slip in his pocket. The date is readable. The signature is not.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: I will be at the end of the alley. Keep anything that could tell us who he went to see.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I need you to hold something for me. Just until morning.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: This slip goes with my debt book. I will leave the book here too. Keep them behind the counter.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: The police are searching houses. Loose pages get lost when strangers handle them.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Everything I have collected is in that book. People trust you. It will be safe here.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Do not open it. If anyone asks, you never saw me tonight.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: You opened it.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: That line is private. Close the book.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Binh paid on Friday. I know what the receipt says.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I entered the loan again. I needed the money. He came back and would not leave without the book.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: I pushed him. He hit the step. He was still breathing when I shut the gate.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: Open up. We can fix the figures together.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: GIVE ME THE BOOK.

speaker: hanh
quote: Hanh: You sell a little on credit every day. You know how easy it is to change one line.

speaker: phuc
quote: Phuc: Step away from the gate, Hanh. Keep the book where I can see it.

speaker: shopkeeper
quote: The ledger shows Binh's one-million-VND payment on Friday, signed by Hanh. The same loan was entered again on Saturday without any new cash being paid out. Binh's account is crossed out.
